source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Confirm the correct specification is being applied, that the data is correctly extracted with data collection forms, that the data is not missing (including any special instructions), and that the data analysis is properly calculated and applied in the report. These are the three most important items in testing a product.
3. Check the wording in the specifications, they need to clearly describe the performance limit to address properly. Don't miss any qualifiers. An example is "at the threshold".
4. Check the data and the calculations in the test records.
5. Verify that all the data is there. Even in failure tests, you need to collect all the data.
6. Verify the calculations for the parameters addressed in the failure. In some cases, it is not an obvious error, but a correct calculation only slightly below the specification that just happens to indicate a failure. Make sure that your understanding of the specified parameters and the definition of how the calculation are made
